purpose: Supplemental ability facts fetched from current RuneScape Wiki ability pages to make the wiki Revolution++ bars calculable. Every value comes from the linked page's current revision (June 2026), captured 2026-07-25.

source_policy.game_values: RuneScape Wiki current ability pages (infobox and mechanics sections)
source_policy.notes: Averages are wiki-stated values; degenerate single-value bands state exactly what the page states. Secondary buff mechanics are documented in notes until the engine models them.

abilities.name: Flurry
effects: Eight hits over 4.8 seconds, one every 0.6 seconds
Empowered at 4+ Bloodlust: +1% damage per 1% of the target's missing life points, cap +65%

abilities.name: Greater Fury
effects: The next non-bleed melee attack within 15 seconds is a guaranteed critical strike (first hit of channelled abilities only)

abilities.name: Greater Sunshine
effects: Applies a damage-over-time to the primary target inside the beam: 10-20% ability damage every 1.8 seconds for 39 seconds
The DoT is not influenced by magic level or equipment stats
Damage buff begins 1 tick after cast and lasts 38.4 seconds

abilities.name: Combust
effects: Burn: ten hits over 18 seconds, one every 1.8 seconds; the percentage is rolled on the first hit and repeated

abilities.name: Sacrifice
effects: Constitution ability, usable with any combat style
